paite: Huan Jobin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: Bangtan ka kha hihbuaia, thutea honhihjan gawp ding na hi ua?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

paite: Hiai sawmvei tak na honkouta ua: ka tunga giloutaka na hih uh na zum kei ua.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

paite: Huan na na paikhialta mawng leng maw, keimah kianga ka diklouhna om gige hi.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

paite: Kei demin nou kiliansak petmah ve nuchin, ka minsiatna ka tungah gen ven uchin:
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;

paite: Pathianin ka thu ah honzouta chih tuin thei un, huan a lenin a honum suak hi.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

paite: Ngai un, Hiamgamna, chiin ka kikou khiaa, himahleh jakin ka om kei: panpih deihin ka kikoua, himahleh vaihawmna a om kei hi.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

paite: Ka pai theihlouhna dingin ka lampi a um a, huan ka paina dingte ah khomial a koih hi.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

paite: Ka thupina honsuahsaka, ka lu akipan lallukhu a la.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

paite: Ning chitengah a hon hihniama, ka mangta hi: huan, sing bangin ka lametna a bot khia.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.

paite: Ka tungah a hehna leng a soua, amah adingin a galte laka khat bangin a honsim hi.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

paite: A sepaihpawlte a hongkuan khawm ua, ka siatna dingin a lampi uh a bawl uh, huan ka puanin kimvelin puanin a kai uh.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

paite: Kei akipanin ka unaute gamlapi ah a koiha, ka mel-theihte kei akipanin a mituam vekta uh.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

paite: Ka tanauten a honjuausanta ua, huan ka lawm theihngeiten a honmangngilhta uh.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

paite: Ka in tengte leh, ka sikhanuten, mikhual a honsa ua: a mitmuh un namdangmi ka hi.
english: Those who dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

paite: Ka sikha ka sama, a hondawng kei, ka kamin amah khem mahleng leng.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

paite: Ka ji adingin muhthadahhuai ka hia, ka nu tate adingin, kihhuai.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

paite: Naupang neute nangawnin a honsimmoh ua; ka thoh leh, ka siatna dingin thu a gen uhi.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

paite: Ka lawm gilte tengtengin kei a honhua ua: huan amau ka itte ka tungah a hel uh.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

paite: Ka guh ka vun ah leh ka sa ah a belh bikbeka, huan ka ha vun toh ka suakta hi.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

paite: Honhehpih un, honhehpih un, Aw nou ka lawmte; Pathian khutin kei a honkhoihta ngala.
english: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.

paite: Bangdia Pathian banga nou honsawi na hi ua, ka saa bangdia lungkim lou na hi ua?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

paite: Aw ka thute tuin gelhin om le uh aw; Aw laibu ah kigelh lut le aw;
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

paite: Sik leh ngen gelhna zumin khantawn adingin suangpia gelh hile uh aw;
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

paite: Himahleh ka Tanpa a hing chih leh, leitungah a tawp chiangin a ding ding chih ka thei hi:
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

paite: Huan ka vun huchibanga hihsiata a om khit nungin, himahleh ka sa akipan Pathian ka mu ding hi:
english: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,

paite: Keimah adingin amah keimahmahin ka mu dia, huan ka miten a en dia, midang hi louin. Ka sungah ka lungtang a sidangta hi!
english: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

paite: Amah bangchibangin i sawi ta phet diamah; na chih uleh, kei ah thu bul muhin a om chih theiin;Namsau kihta un: hehnain lah namsau gawtnate a hontun ngala, huchia vaihawmna a om chih na theih theihna ding un.
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

paite: Namsau kihta un: hehnain lah namsau gawtnate a hontun ngala, huchia vaihawmna a om chih na theih theihna ding un.
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
